You may enable online, where available, a universal tool that automatically communicates your opt-out, such as Global Privacy Control (“GPC”), which we’ll process as if you had opted out through the toggle.Even if you opt out, you may continue to see advertising, including ads that may be based on personal information processed before you opted out.
